name: Iizuka Takeya
source: Third-year student at Houjou High School, he serves as the president and lead guitarist of the Light Music Club. Carefree and infamous as a womanizer, he nonetheless cares deeply for his close friends—especially Haruki, to whom he is fiercely loyal yet unafraid to call out when he makes mistakes.
